definition: Theaitre (stylized as THEaiTRE) is an interdisciplinary research project investigating to what extent artificial intelligence is able to generate theatre play scripts.
details: The first theatre play produced within the project, AI: When a Robot Writes a Play, premiered online on February 26, 2021.

explainer.lead: Theaitre (THEaiTRE) is an interdisciplinary research project asking to what extent AI can generate theatre play scripts. Its first play, AI: When a Robot Writes a Play, premiered online on February 26, 2021.

tiers.eli5: It is a research project that tests whether a computer can write a play, and it staged one to find out.
tiers.practitioner: The project treats script generation as an open research question spanning AI and theatre. A pitfall is that generated scripts need human dramaturgical judgment, which is why the work is framed as interdisciplinary rather than fully automated.
tiers.paperLevel: An interdisciplinary research project investigating the extent to which AI can generate theatre play scripts, with a premiere on February 26, 2021. No formal method or evaluation metric is specified.

explainer.example: The project's first output, AI: When a Robot Writes a Play, was performed and premiered online on February 26, 2021.
